how_used: feed_fetcher.py v10 reads this file on every run. live=true sources are checked every run: rss = direct feed, google_news = per-source Google News search (last 14 days), pages = news/listing pages read directly. live=false = reference only (Sources panel), not fetched.

sources.name: RCL — Government Legislation Centre (Rządowy Proces Legislacyjny)
sources.adds: Draft laws and consultation stages before they reach Sejm (RES Act, nuclear, capacity market, CfD) | Draft texts, explanatory memoranda, consultation deadlines and revisions before a bill reaches the Sejm. Complements the Cabinet work list and parliamentary feeds.

sources.name: President's Office (Kancelaria Prezydenta)
sources.adds: Signatures and vetoes on energy laws; political-risk signal

sources.name: Senate of Poland
sources.adds: Senate amendments to energy bills | Committee agendas, hearings, amendments and votes after bills move from the Sejm. Start with the Climate and Environment Committee.

sources.name: Sejm API — committees (Energy, Climate & State Assets)
sources.adds: Committee agendas and hearings ahead of plenary votes

sources.name: Monitor Polski (via ELI)
sources.adds: Council of Ministers resolutions and notices not published in Dziennik Ustaw

sources.name: Council of Ministers communiqués
sources.adds: Cabinet decisions on energy bills, strategies and programmes

sources.name: Ministry of Finance
sources.adds: State guarantees, nuclear financing, fiscal backing for CfDs

sources.name: Ministry of Industry
sources.adds: Nuclear supply chain, coal-sector restructuring

sources.name: Ministry of Infrastructure
sources.adds: Ports, offshore logistics, grid-related infrastructure

sources.name: NABE — National Energy Security Agency (coal-asset carve-out)
sources.adds: Coal plant transfers, closures and funding. Confirm official domain on first run

sources.name: Government plenipotentiary for strategic energy infrastructure
sources.adds: Nuclear programme and grid-infrastructure statements

sources.name: Maritime Offices — Gdynia, Słupsk, Szczecin
sources.adds: Offshore wind permits for artificial islands and installations | Marine orders and notices on offshore construction areas, export-cable safety zones and restrictions that can indicate a new phase of work.

sources.name: EkoPortal — environmental information register
sources.adds: EIA decisions and public notices for plants, nuclear and offshore (complements GDOŚ) | Search by developer, municipality or project name for environmental applications and decisions across participating authorities. This can identify projects registered under local subsidiaries or special-purpose companies.

sources.name: dane.gov.pl — open data portal
sources.adds: URE and ministry registers and datasets for data alerts

sources.name: ACER — EU energy regulators agency
sources.adds: Capacity-mechanism opinions, market monitoring reports | Capacity mechanism design, security of supply and analysis of Polish battery participation in the capacity market. Use new reports to identify policy and revenue changes to follow.

sources.name: EC DG COMP — State Aid Register
sources.adds: Structured state-aid cases: capacity mechanism, nuclear, CfD, coal derogations | Case-level State aid decisions and conditions for support schemes and individual projects. Track case IDs for offshore support, nuclear financing and capacity-market measures.

sources.name: EC DG ENER — news
sources.adds: EU energy policy affecting Poland

sources.name: CJEU / General Court
sources.adds: Legal challenges to Polish state-aid decisions

sources.name: KNF — Polish Financial Supervision Authority
sources.adds: Prospectuses and bond approvals by energy issuers

sources.name: PSE — capacity market portal
sources.adds: Auction parameters/results, certified units incl. BESS and CCGT. Deeper than PSE news query

sources.name: PSE — grid development plan & adequacy reports
sources.adds: Capacity-need forecasts, coal phase-out assumptions, connection pipeline

sources.name: GAZ-SYSTEM
sources.adds: Gas grid connections for CCGT/CHP, LNG/FSRU capacity — key for gas FIDs | Gas connection agreements, pipeline construction and tie-in schedules for new gas-fired units. Track individual connection milestones that can affect commissioning.

sources.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
sources.adds: Generation, installed capacity, outages for Poland

sources.name: ENTSOG / GIE AGSI+
sources.adds: Gas flows and storage — context for gas-fired generation

sources.name: NFOŚiGW — National Fund for Environmental Protection
sources.adds: Energy-storage, cogeneration and heat programmes; Transformation Fund calls | Utility-scale storage funding calls, results, beneficiary lists and contracted support. Check programme pages and attachments for CHP and energy-system modernisation programmes as well.

sources.name: BGK — Modernisation / Energy Transformation Fund
sources.adds: Fund disbursements and state-backed financing | Polish offshore-wind loan programmes, application windows, eligibility and financing disclosures. Adds domestic financing coverage to the existing EIB and EU recovery sources.

sources.name: EBRD — Poland projects
sources.adds: Project Summary Documents and loans for Polish energy | Pipeline disclosures, borrower and project-company names, proposed financing, project status and environmental documents for renewables and storage. Capture the lender’s stated status.

sources.name: CINEA — Innovation Fund / CEF Energy
sources.adds: EU grants for storage, CCS and grids

sources.name: EKF — Danish export credit
sources.adds: Offshore wind export financing

sources.name: UK Export Finance
sources.adds: Export-credit support for Polish energy projects

sources.name: US DFC
sources.adds: US financing for Polish nuclear and energy

sources.name: Credit-rating press releases (Fitch · S&P · Moody's)
sources.adds: Rating actions on PGE, Enea, TAURON, ORLEN, Energa

sources.name: PSEW — Polish Wind Energy Association
sources.adds: Onshore/offshore policy, repowering, auctions | Onshore siting rules, repowering barriers, auction commentary and offshore supply-chain developments. Track industry positions and issues raised during consultations.

sources.name: TGPE — Polish Power Plants Association
sources.adds: Thermal generator positions on capacity market and coal

sources.name: PTPiREE — Transmission & Distribution Association
sources.adds: Connections, curtailment, storage integration

sources.name: PKEE — Polish Electricity Committee
sources.adds: Industry view on market design

sources.name: Polish PV Association (PSF)
sources.adds: Utility-scale solar and regulation | Utility-scale solar and storage policy, consultation positions and industry responses to proposed changes affecting investment and grid access.

sources.name: POLSIE — Polish Chamber of Renewable & Distributed Energy
sources.adds: RES and distributed energy, PPAs

sources.name: Polish heating chamber (Izba Gospodarcza Ciepłownictwo Polskie)
sources.adds: CHP modernisation and district-heating fuel switching | District-heating and CHP modernisation, fuel switching, operator procurement and heat-sector policy positions. Public tenders and notices can identify smaller projects.

sources.name: Polish energy storage association (PSME)
sources.adds: BESS regulation and market. Confirm exact name/domain | Storage permitting and grid connection rules, financing schemes and discussion of revenue from capacity, balancing and flexibility markets.

sources.name: Instrat Foundation
sources.adds: Open data and analysis: prices, coal, nuclear economics | Public plant database and maps for matching news to units, owners, capacity and technology. Establish a baseline for closures, conversions and replacements.

sources.name: WiseEuropa
sources.adds: Energy transition policy analysis

sources.name: Polish Economic Institute (PIE)
sources.adds: Energy cost and policy analysis

sources.name: Instytut Jagielloński
sources.adds: Nuclear and energy-security commentary

sources.name: WindEurope
sources.adds: Offshore auction design and permitting across EU

sources.name: SolarPower Europe
sources.adds: Solar and BESS outlooks

sources.name: FORATOM
sources.adds: EU nuclear policy and financing

sources.name: KRS Open API
sources.adds: Board changes, capital increases, mergers, new SPVs for named KRS numbers | On-demand checks of company identity, management, registered changes and available financial filings for Polish project companies. Useful when a release cites an unfamiliar subsidiary.

sources.name: Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy (MSiG)
sources.adds: Merger/split notices, insolvency and restructuring announcements

sources.name: eKRS — financial statements repository
sources.adds: SPV and project-company financials

sources.name: PAP MediaRoom
sources.adds: Corporate press releases

sources.name: Newseria Biznes
sources.adds: Corporate and executive statements on energy

sources.adds: Policy leaks and legislative detail

sources.name: Business Insider Polska
sources.adds: Executive changes, state-company strategy

sources.name: Interia Biznes
sources.adds: General business, energy prices

sources.name: TVN24 Biznes
sources.adds: Political developments affecting the sector

sources.adds: Politics and economy beyond energia.rp.pl

sources.adds: Trade-magazine coverage of RES and heat

sources.name: offshoreWIND.biz
sources.adds: Baltic offshore projects, auctions, supply chain | Poland-filtered coverage of offshore auctions, supplier awards, installation campaigns, vessels and commissioning. Helps identify subcontractors and awards below the main EPC level.

sources.name: Offshore Energy
sources.adds: Offshore wind, ports, vessels

sources.adds: Wind and solar project news

sources.adds: SMR and large-reactor technical news

sources.adds: Nuclear industry news

sources.name: POWER Magazine
sources.adds: Thermal and nuclear sector trends

sources.adds: EU energy policy, Poland's positions

sources.name: Energy Monitor
sources.adds: Transition analysis

sources.name: bne IntelliNews
sources.adds: CEE and Polish energy business

sources.name: TVP World
sources.adds: English-language Polish news | English coverage of Polish nuclear, offshore wind and major energy policy developments. Useful for discovery and for tracing stories to the original announcement.

sources.name: Poland In
sources.adds: English-language Polish news

sources.name: Corporate wires (Business Wire · GlobeNewswire · PR Newswire)
sources.adds: English-language corporate announcements

sources.name: Argus · Montel · S&P Global (free headlines only)
sources.adds: Headlines only; most content paywalled

sources.name: Equinor (Bałtyk 2/3)
sources.adds: Offshore milestones with Polenergia | Bałtyk 2 and 3 contractor and construction updates, plus financial close, lender participation and investment decisions from Equinor.

sources.name: Northland Power / Baltic Power
sources.adds: Offshore project under construction | Project-level turbine and substation installation, grid delivery, commissioning and operating milestones.

sources.name: KGHM — SMR / own generation
sources.adds: SMR plans and self-generation | Buyer-side corporate PPA developments, including procurement notices before signature, plus SMR partnerships and siting developments.

sources.name: Orlen Synthos Green Energy (OSGE)
sources.adds: BWRX-300 SMR programme | SMR site selection, shareholder agreements, design and licensing steps, vendor contracts and requests for government support. Project-company detail complements ORLEN group disclosures.

sources.name: Westinghouse / Bechtel — Poland nuclear
sources.adds: EPC progress on large reactor project | Large nuclear EPC negotiations, site handover, long-lead procurement and Polish supplier agreements. Compare the two contractors’ disclosures for additional details.

sources.name: KHNP — Pątnów nuclear (with ZE PAK)
sources.adds: Korean nuclear proposal progress

sources.name: Siemens Energy · GE Vernova · Mitsubishi Power · Wärtsilä · INNIO
sources.adds: CCGT/OCGT/gas-engine orders, delays and OEM supply constraints | CCGT turbine orders, EPC scope, commissioning and first operation. Nuclear releases also cover BWRX-300 design and supplier milestones relevant to Poland. | Gas-engine orders and coal-to-gas projects. Supplier announcements can identify engine count, technology and project scope for projects with limited national coverage.

sources.name: Vestas · Nordex · Siemens Gamesa · Enercon
sources.adds: Onshore repowering and offshore turbine supply

sources.name: Fluence · Tesla · Sungrow · BYD · Hithium · CATL
sources.adds: BESS supply-chain deals

sources.name: Budimex · Polimex Mostostal · Mostostal Warszawa (listed EPCs)
sources.adds: EPC contract awards, backlog and margins | EPC and subcontract awards, execution milestones, contract amendments and changes in the contractor’s order book. Follow public news and current reports for supplier-side detail.

sources.name: Bogdanka · PGG (coal)
sources.adds: Coal supply and closure schedules

sources.name: Mid-size RES/BESS developers (Respect Energy, Columbus, Photon, Greenvolt, Qair, R.Power, Lightsource bp, Statkraft)
sources.adds: Mid-size RES/BESS deals, PPAs, M&A | BESS portfolio sales, lender commitments, equipment agreements, construction starts and commissioning. Follow the same battery project across successive milestones. | Utility-scale solar development and corporate PPAs. The company’s Polish solar agreement with Microsoft illustrates the value of following the developer newsroom alongside BP’s corporate site.

sources.name: Ports: Gdańsk · Baltic Hub · Szczecin-Świnoujście
sources.adds: Offshore wind installation hubs

sources.name: Global Energy Monitor (coal & gas plant trackers)
sources.adds: Coal closures and new gas builds — data alerts | Unit-level coal fleet baselines, announced phase-out dates and retirement status. Verify possible closures or conversions with the operator or public authority.

sources.name: Ember
sources.adds: Poland generation mix and price data

sources.name: Energy-Charts (Fraunhofer ISE)
sources.adds: Public generation and price data incl. Poland

sources.name: KOBiZE — EU ETS administrator
sources.adds: EU ETS and free allocation; emissions of coal/gas units

sources.name: ARE — Energy Market Agency
sources.adds: Market statistics and analysis

sources.name: GUS — Statistics Poland
sources.adds: Energy statistics and capacity data

sources.name: NCBJ — National Centre for Nuclear Research
sources.adds: HTGR/SMR research and nuclear workforce

sources.name: Polish law-firm briefings (Wardyński · Rymarz Zdort · DZP · Bird & Bird)
sources.adds: Legal analysis of energy law changes

sources.name: EEX Transparency and ACER’s REMIT portal
sources.adds: Unit-level planned and unplanned outages, revisions to availability and return-to-service dates. Use the ACER directory to find additional public disclosure platforms.

sources.name: Regional environmental directorates (RDOŚ)
sources.adds: Environmental proceedings, decisions, amendments and appeals. Start with Gdańsk for Baltic coast projects and Poznań for onshore wind. Extend coverage as new projects enter the watchlist.

sources.name: GUNB construction register (RWDZ)
sources.adds: Search building-permit applications and decisions within the register’s coverage. Check construction permit progress for wind, solar, storage and related infrastructure.

sources.name: Pomorskie Voivodeship Office
sources.adds: Regional construction and siting notices for major coastal infrastructure and nuclear projects, including applications for the first large nuclear plant.

sources.name: PGE Baltica
sources.adds: Offshore procurement plans, supplier packages and stakeholder documents. Use these to identify planned tender windows and changes in delivery sequencing.

sources.name: TAURON Dystrybucja and Enea Operator
sources.adds: Distribution-level flexibility calls, participation rules and storage connection requirements. Compare how each operator implements flexibility services and track local revenue opportunities.

sources.name: OX2
sources.adds: Polish wind, solar and storage development, capacity-market awards, construction starts and asset sales. The Polish page is more focused than the group newsroom.

sources.name: European Energy
sources.adds: Polish wind and solar development, battery auction awards, asset disposals and corporate PPA announcements involving Polish assets or buyers.

sources.name: Ignitis Group
sources.adds: Poland-tagged project announcements, investment activity and portfolio developments from a regional developer outside the original peer list.

sources.name: GOLDBECK SOLAR
sources.adds: EPC awards for Polish utility-scale PV and co-located or standalone storage. Supplier releases may identify the contracting entity, equipment package and capacity in MW or MWh.

sources.name: Utility procurement portals
sources.adds: Buyer-side tender launches, amendments, extensions and cancellations. Public listings and attachments can provide more detail than group press releases.

sources.name: ENTSO-E adequacy assessments
sources.group: Policy, market design and independent reporting
sources.adds: Poland’s adequacy outlook, changes in capacity assumptions and seasonal supply risks. Adds context for future procurement of dispatchable capacity or storage.

sources.name: GospodarkaMorska.pl
sources.group: Policy, market design and independent reporting
sources.adds: Polish coverage of ports, factories, vessel activity, cable and substation logistics and local offshore suppliers.

sources.name: GLOBENERGIA
sources.group: Policy, market design and independent reporting
sources.adds: BESS projects, construction and commissioning updates, grants and renewables regulation. Filter the storage section for utility-scale projects.
